title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: What does the category (Lists, Tasks, Administration, Archive……) mean when searching from Tell Me? (Usage Category)
summary: The UsageCategory property in AL determines how pages, reports, and queries appear when users search via Tell Me in Business Central. Setting this property correctly categorizes objects in search results and the role explorer, helping users navigate and improving productivity.
key_points: UsageCategory is an AL property that makes pages, reports and queries show up in Tell Me; if it is None or not set, the object does not appear in search
The property has seven options: None, Lists, Tasks, ReportsAndAnalysis, Documents, History and Administration; History is shown as Archive in Tell Me
Lists, Tasks and Administration fall under Pages and Tasks, while ReportsAndAnalysis, Documents and History fall under Reports and Analysis
Role explorer uses UsageCategory too: its Reports and Analysis and Administration actions show objects set to those values
Queries can be added to Tell Me starting with BC23.1

quotes.text: A consistent approach helps guiding the user and improves productivity.
quotes.why_it_matters: This emphasizes that consistent categorization of objects is a best practice that directly impacts user experience and efficiency in finding what they need.
